cases.sentence: Бог славы явился нашему праотцу Аврааму, когда он жил еще в Месопотамии, до того, как он поселился в том ___.
cases.translation: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was still in Mesopotamia, before he settled in that place.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Оставь свою страну и своих ___ сказал Бог ему.
cases.translation: Leave your country and your relatives, God said to him.
cases.explain: The imperative verb оставь (leave) takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Бог не дал ему здесь никакого наследия, не дал ___ даже на ширину ступни.
cases.translation: God gave him no inheritance here, not even land the width of a footstep.
cases.explain: The transitive verb дал (gave) takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Бог обещал дать эту землю во владение ему и его ___, хотя в то время у Авраама не было ребенка.
cases.translation: God promised to give this land as a possession to him and to his descendants, even though at that time Abraham had no child.
cases.explain: The preposition 'и его' here functions with genitive when referring to possession and heirs.

cases.sentence: Авраам стал отцом Исаака и обрезал его на восьмой день после ___.
cases.translation: Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day after his birth.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Патриархи из зависти к Иосифу продали его в ___.
cases.translation: The patriarchs out of jealousy toward Joseph sold him into Egypt.
cases.explain: The verb продали (sold) with the preposition в indicating direction of motion takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Моисей был научен всей египетской мудрости. Он был силен и в слове, и в ___.
cases.translation: Moses was trained in all Egyptian wisdom. He was mighty in both word and deed.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Он подошел ближе, чтобы лучше рассмотреть, и услышал голос ___.
cases.translation: He approached to get a better look and heard the voice of the Lord.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to indicate possession: the voice belonging to the Lord.

reading.ru: Бог славы явился нашему праотцу Аврааму, когда он жил еще в Месопотамии, до того, как он поселился в Харане.
reading.question: Where was Abraham living when God first appeared to him?
reading.explain: Stephen says the God of glory appeared to Abraham when he was still in Mesopotamia (Месопотамии), before he settled in Haran.

reading.ru: Бог говорил ему, твои потомки будут странниками в чужой земле, они будут обращены в рабство и будут терпеть зло четыреста лет.
reading.question: For how long were Abraham's descendants to be enslaved?
reading.explain: God said Abraham's descendants would suffer slavery and mistreatment for four hundred years (четыреста лет).

reading.ru: Патриархи из зависти к Иосифу продали его в Египет. Но Бог был с ним и избавил его от всех бед.
reading.question: What happened to Joseph when he was sold into Egypt?
options: God was with him and delivered him from all afflictions
He became an enemy of his brothers
He lost his faith in God
reading.correct: God was with him and delivered him from all afflictions
reading.explain: Despite being sold into Egypt out of jealousy, God was with Joseph and delivered him from all afflictions (избавил его от всех бед).

reading.ru: Через сорок лет Моисею явился ангел в пламени горящего тернового куста в пустыне, недалеко от горы Синай.
reading.question: How did God appear to Moses in the wilderness?
options: In a bright light from heaven
In a flame of fire in a burning thorn bush
As a man with a sword
reading.correct: In a flame of fire in a burning thorn bush
reading.explain: An angel appeared to Moses in the flame of fire within a burning thorn bush (в пламени горящего тернового куста) in the wilderness.

reading.ru: Сними свою обувь, потому что место, на котором ты стоишь, — святая земля.
reading.question: Why did God tell Moses to remove his sandals?
options: Because the place he stood on was holy ground
Because he was about to wade through water
Because he had walked too far
reading.correct: Because the place he stood on was holy ground
reading.explain: God commanded Moses to remove his sandals because the place on which he stood was holy ground (святая земля).

reading.ru: Стефан же, исполненный Святого Духа, поднял глаза к небу и увидел славу Божию и Иисуса, стоящего по правую руку от Бога.
reading.question: What did Stephen see when he looked up to heaven?
options: The glory of God and Jesus standing at God's right hand
reading.correct: The glory of God and Jesus standing at God's right hand
reading.explain: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Stephen saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God (Иисуса, стоящего по правую руку от Бога).
